name: The Missing Courier
summary: Ginro Hearthkindle tells you the courier, Raschal, set out for Thalanaar about a week ago, planning to row down the coast. Ginro could not find the boat and asks you to look for it along the coast of Feralas, in case it holds a clue to where Raschal is.

sections.title: A Route Down the Coast
sections.body: About a week ago Raschal set out for Thalanaar. Raschal knows Feralas well and has been with the expeditionary forces since General Feathermoon led them here. Ginro's understanding is that Raschal meant to go by row boat down the coast and cross southern Feralas, avoiding the Horde camp. Ginro could not find the boat, which may be hidden or sunk, and asks you to look for it along the coast of Feralas, since it might hold a clue to where Raschal is. On the mainland, the Forgotten Coast stretches south from the jetty.

sections.title: At the Shore
sections.body: Through slightly muddy water you spot a wrecked row boat, riddled with gaping holes along one side and shredded nearly down to its wooden frame. Whatever broke it probably tried to split it in half. A small crest of Feathermoon Stronghold is painted on the other side, and in the mud at the boat's base something metallic glints.

faq.answer: The courier who went missing. Raschal knows Feralas well and has been with the expeditionary forces since General Feathermoon led them here.
To Thalanaar. Raschal planned to go by boat down the coast, then over southern Feralas, to steer clear of the Horde camp.

faq.q: How long has Raschal been missing?
faq.answer: About a week, since setting out for Thalanaar.
This step follows the earlier The Missing Courier, in which you spoke with Ginro Hearthkindle.
